planets.name: HD 136352 d
planets.description: HD 136352 d crosses its star every 107 days and is 2.6 times as wide as Earth, found in 2019.

text.card: HD 136352 d was found in 2019 by La Silla Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 136352. Its orbit and size follow Delrez et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
